title: UI风格#14 - Nordic Minimal (北欧极简)
description: 创建第14种UI风格：北欧极简风格 - 冷灰白、木质调、Form Follows Function。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planN.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Minimal style When color palette Then features whites, soft grays, pale wood tones, minimal accent
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: #FAFAFA white, #E8E8E8 soft gray, #D4B896 birch, #2C3E50 charcoal

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Minimal style When typography Then uses clean fonts: Montserrat, Proza Libre, or Nunito Sans
Given Nordic Minimal style When layout Then extreme whitespace, functional grid, natural light, birch textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: extreme whitespace, birch wood accent line, functional grid, ultra-clean layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Minimal style When UI elements Then flat design, subtle shadows, natural materials, functional buttons
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: flat design, minimal borders, birch accents, functional buttons DO/GO/STOP/CLEAR

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Minimal UI When functional Then includes clean chat, minimal agent cards, essential stats only
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: ultra-clean chat, minimal UNIT cards, essential stats only

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Minimal UI When copy Then uses functional language: 'Essential', 'Pure', 'Clear', 'Simple', 'Clean'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'LESS. IS. MORE.', buttons DO/GO/STOP/CLEAR, status 'Working.../Done.'
